metadata.description: ScreenLasso for Claude: convert and optimize images with the ScreenLasso app on your Mac.

plugins.name: screenlasso
plugins.description: Edit, mark up and convert images, read text, work with colors and QR codes, and convert videos with the ScreenLasso app on your Mac: social media sizes, WebP and AVIF, arrows and numbered steps, HEX/OKLCH/Tailwind and WCAG contrast. Images never leave your Mac.
